{"consolidated_memory":"COMPONENT: worker/queue/consumer.py (background jobs/worker queue side)

ISSUE TYPE: Message redelivery—same message id handled more than once after worker restart

COMMON REPRODUCTION: Kill the worker mid-batch and restart it

---

OCCASION 1 [2026-01-14]
- Environment: staging read replica only
- Root cause: off-by-one error in the slice bound
- Result: 24 duplicate rows per day stopped being written
- Fix: corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
- PR #7600, branch fix/message-redelivery-1

OCCASION 2 [2026-01-25]
- Environment: users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Result: throughput rose 66 percent, reaching 466 requests per second
- Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #8041, branch fix/message-redelivery-2

OCCASION 3 [2026-04-22]
- Environment: clients still pinned to the v1 SDK
- Root cause: naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
- Result: nightly rollup matched source counts for 84 consecutive days
- Fix: made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
- PR #9892, branch fix/message-redelivery-3

NOTE: All three fixes targeted the same corner of worker/queue/consumer.py; earlier message redelivery context carried over across all three occasions."}
